contents.html: The following are requirements on RSA key pairs (see SP 800-57):
contents.html_ja: RSA鍵ペアに関する要件を以下に示す（SP 800-57参照）。

contents.html: Each key pair shall be created using an approved key-generation method as specified in Section 6.3.
contents.html_ja: 各鍵ペアは、第6.3節に規定する承認済み鍵生成方法で生成しなければならない。

contents.html: The private keys and prime factors of the modulus shall be protected from unauthorized access, disclosure, and modification.
contents.html_ja: 秘密鍵および法の素因数は、不正なアクセス、開示および改変から保護しなければならない。

contents.html: Public keys shall be protected from unauthorized modification. This is often accomplished by using public-key certificates that have been signed by a trusted Certification Authority (CA).
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵は不正な改変から保護しなければならない。これは多くの場合、信頼できる認証局（CA）が署名した公開鍵証明書を用いて実現する。

contents.html: A recipient of a public key shall be assured of the integrity and correct association of (a) the public key and (b) an identifier of the entity that owns the key pair (that is, the party with whom the recipient intends to establish secret keying material). This assurance is often provided by verifying a public-key certificate that was signed by a trusted third party (for example, a CA), but may be provided by direct distribution of the public key and identifier from the owner, provided that the recipient trusts the owner and distribution process to do this.
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵の受領者は、(a)公開鍵と(b)鍵ペアを所有する主体（すなわち、受領者が秘密鍵素材を確立しようとする相手）の識別子との完全性および正しい対応付けについて保証を得なければならない。この保証は、信頼できる第三者（CAなど）が署名した公開鍵証明書の検証によって提供されることが多いが、受領者が所有者および配布過程を信頼している場合は、所有者から公開鍵と識別子を直接配布してもよい。

contents.html: One key pair shall not be used for different cryptographic purposes (for example, a digital-signature key pair shall not be used for key establishment or vice versa), with the following possible exception: when requesting the certificate for a public key-establishment key, the private key-establishment key associated with the public key may be used to sign the certificate request (see SP 800-57, Part 1 on Key Usage for further information). A key pair may be used in more than one key-establishment scheme. However, a key pair used for schemes specified in this Recommendation should not be used for any schemes not specified herein.
contents.html_ja: 次の例外が認められる場合を除き、1つの鍵ペアを異なる暗号目的に使用してはならない（例えば、デジタル署名用鍵ペアを鍵確立に使用してはならず、その逆も同様）。例外：公開鍵確立鍵の証明書を要求する際、その公開鍵に対応する秘密鍵確立鍵を証明書要求への署名に使ってもよい（鍵用途の詳細はSP 800-57 Part 1参照）。鍵ペアは複数の鍵確立スキームで使用してもよい。ただし、本勧告で規定するスキーム用の鍵ペアを、本書に規定されないスキームに使用するべきではない。

contents.html: The owner of a key pair shall have assurance of the key pair’s validity (see Section 6.4.1.1); that is, the owner shall have assurance of the correct generation of the key pair (see Section 6.3), consistent with the criteria of Section 6.2; assurance of private and public-key validity; and assurance of pair-wise consistency.
contents.html_ja: 鍵ペアの所有者は、その鍵ペアの妥当性の保証を得なければならない（第6.4.1.1節参照）。すなわち、第6.2節の基準に適合する正しい生成（第6.3節参照）、秘密鍵および公開鍵の妥当性、ならびにペアワイズ整合性について保証を得る。

contents.html: A recipient of a public key shall have assurance of the validity of the public key (see Section 6.4.2.1). This assurance may be provided, for example, through the use of a public-key certificate if the CA obtains sufficient assurance of public-key validity as part of its certification process.
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵の受領者は、その公開鍵の妥当性の保証を得なければならない（第6.4.2.1節参照）。例えば、CAが認証プロセスの一環として公開鍵の妥当性について十分な保証を得ている場合、公開鍵証明書を用いてこの保証を提供してもよい。

contents.html: A recipient of a public key shall have assurance of the owner’s possession of the associated private key (see Section 6.4.2.3). This assurance may be provided, for example, through the use of a public key certificate if the CA obtains sufficient assurance of possession as part of its certification process.
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵の受領者は、所有者が対応する秘密鍵を所持している保証を得なければならない（第6.4.2.3節参照）。例えば、CAが認証プロセスの一環として所持について十分な保証を得ている場合、公開鍵証明書を用いてこの保証を提供してもよい。

contents.html: 6.2 Criteria for RSA Key Pairs for Key Establishment
contents.html_ja: 6.2 鍵確立用RSA鍵ペアの基準

contents.html: 6.2.1 Definition of a Key Pair
contents.html_ja: 6.2.1 鍵ペアの定義

contents.html: A valid RSA key pair, in its basic form, shall consist of an RSA public key (n, e) and an RSA private key (n, d), where:
contents.html_ja: 有効な基本形式のRSA鍵ペアは、RSA公開鍵(n, e)およびRSA秘密鍵(n, d)で構成しなければならない。ここで：

contents.html: n, the public modulus, shall be the product of exactly two distinct, odd positive prime factors, p and q, that are kept secret. Let len(n) = nBits, the bit length of n; len(n) is required to be even.
contents.html_ja: n（公開法）は、互いに異なる2つの奇正素数pおよびqの積でなければならず、pとqは秘密に保持する。len(n) = nBitsとし、nのビット長len(n)は偶数でなければならない。

contents.html: The public exponent e shall be an odd integer that is selected prior to the generation of p and q such that: 65,537 ≤ e < 2256
contents.html_ja: 公開指数eは奇整数でなければならず、pおよびqの生成前に選択し、65,537 ≤ e < 2^256を満たす。

contents.html: The prime factors p and q shall be generated using one of the methods specified in Appendix B.3 of FIPS 186 such that: a. 2(nBits − 1)/2 < p < 2nBits/2. b. 2(nBits − 1)/2 < q < 2nBits/2. c. |p – q| > 2nBits/2−100.
contents.html_ja: 素因数pおよびqはFIPS 186付録B.3のいずれかの方法で生成し、次を満たさなければならない。a. 2^((nBits−1)/2) < p < 2^(nBits/2)。b. 2^((nBits−1)/2) < q < 2^(nBits/2)。c. |p − q| > 2^(nBits/2−100)。

contents.html: d. The exponent e must be mutually prime with both p − 1 and q − 1: GCD(e, LCM(p − 1, q − 1)) = 1.
contents.html_ja: d. 指数eはp − 1およびq − 1の両方と互いに素でなければならない：GCD(e, LCM(p − 1, q − 1)) = 1。

contents.html: The primes p and q, and the private exponent d shall be selected such that: a. 2nBits/2 < d < LCM(p−1, q−1), and b. d = e−1 mod (LCM(p−1, q−1)). Regarding step 4a: One can be certain that the inequality 2nBits/2 < d will be satisfied even before d is computed by verifying that LCM(p−1, q−1) ≥ (e)( 2nBits/2 ). The second inequality, d < LCM(p−1, q−1), will be satisfied if d is computed as specified in step b).
contents.html_ja: 素数pとq、および秘密指数dは次を満たすよう選択しなければならない。a. 2^(nBits/2) < d < LCM(p−1, q−1)。b. d = e⁻¹ mod LCM(p−1, q−1)。手順4aについて：dを計算する前でも、LCM(p−1, q−1) ≥ e × 2^(nBits/2)を検証すれば、2^(nBits/2) < dの不等式が成立すると確認できる。2つ目の不等式d < LCM(p−1, q−1)は、手順bのとおりdを計算すれば成立する。

contents.html: Note that these criteria are also specified in FIPS 186.
contents.html_ja: これらの基準はFIPS 186にも規定されている。

contents.html: 6.2.2 Formats

The RSA private key may be expressed in several formats. The basic format of the RSA private key consists of the modulus n and a private-key exponent d that depends on n and the public-key exponent e; this format is used to specify the RSA primitives and operations in Section 7. The other two formats may be used in implementations, but may require appropriate modifications for correct implementation. To facilitate implementation testing, the format for the private key shall be one of the following:
contents.html_ja: RSA秘密鍵は複数の形式で表現できる。基本形式は、法nと、nおよび公開指数eに依存する秘密指数dから成る。この形式は第7節のRSAプリミティブおよび操作を規定するために用いる。他の2形式も実装で使用できるが、正しく実装するには適切な変更が必要となる場合がある。実装試験を容易にするため、秘密鍵は次のいずれかの形式でなければならない。

contents.html: The basic format: (n, d).
contents.html_ja: 基本形式：(n, d)。

contents.html: The prime-factor format: (p, q, d).
contents.html_ja: 素因数形式：(p, q, d)。

contents.html: The Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT) format: (n, e, d, p, q, dP, dQ, qInv), where dP = d mod (p – 1), dQ = d mod (q – 1), and qInv = q–1 mod p. Note that Section 7.1.2 discusses the use of the private key expressed using the CRT format during the execution of the RSA decryption primitive.
contents.html_ja: 中国剰余定理（CRT）形式：(n, e, d, p, q, dP, dQ, qInv)。ここでdP = d mod (p−1)、dQ = d mod (q−1)、qInv = q⁻¹ mod pである。第7.1.2節では、RSA復号プリミティブの実行中にCRT形式の秘密鍵を用いることを説明する。

contents.html: Key-pair generators and key-pair validation methods are given for each of these formats in Sections 6.3 and 6.4, respectively.
contents.html_ja: 各形式の鍵ペア生成器と鍵ペア検証方法は、それぞれ第6.3節および第6.4節に示す。

contents.html: 6.3 RSA Key-Pair Generators
contents.html_ja: 6.3 RSA鍵ペア生成器

contents.html: The key pairs employed by the key-establishment schemes specified in this Recommendation shall be generated using the techniques specified in Appendix B.3 of FIPS 186, employing the requisite methods for prime-number generation, primality testing, etc., that are specified in Appendix C of that document. Note that these generation methods ensure that the prime factors p and q have the same bit length and that their product, n (the RSA modulus), has a bit length that is exactly twice the length of its factors. An approved RSA key-pair generator and approved random bit generator (RBG) shall be used to produce an RSA key pair. Any modulus with an even bit length that provides at least 112 bits of security strength may be used. Commonly used modulus lengths and their associated security strengths are given in Table 2. For other modulus lengths, Appendix D provides a method for estimating the security strength that can be supported. Table 2: Security Strengths Supported by Commonly Used Modulus Lengths17
contents.html_ja: 本勧告で規定する鍵確立スキームで使用する鍵ペアは、FIPS 186付録B.3の技法に従い、同文書付録Cの素数生成、素数判定等の必要な方法を用いて生成しなければならない。これらの生成方法により、素因数pとqは同じビット長となり、その積n（RSA法）のビット長は素因数の長さのちょうど2倍となる。承認済みRSA鍵ペア生成器と承認済み乱数ビット生成器（RBG）を用いてRSA鍵ペアを生成しなければならない。少なくとも112ビットのセキュリティ強度を提供する偶数ビット長の法を使用してよい。一般的に使用される法長と対応するセキュリティ強度を表2に示す。他の法長については、付録Dにサポート可能なセキュリティ強度を推定する方法を示す。表2：一般的に使用される法長がサポートするセキュリティ強度¹⁷

contents.html: Approved RBGs are discussed in Section 5.3. The approved RSA key-pair generators are provided in Sections 6.3.1 and 6.3.2, and are differentiated by the method for determining the public-key exponent e that is used as part of an RSA public key (i.e., (n, e)); Section 6.3.1 addresses the use of a fixed value for the exponent, whereas Section 6.3.2 uses a randomly generated value. For the following methods in Section 6.3 and the assurances in Section 6.4, let ES(nBits) denote the estimated maximum security strength for a modulus of bit length nBits as determined by Table 2 or Appendix D.
contents.html_ja: 承認済みRBGは第5.3節で説明する。承認済みRSA鍵ペア生成器は第6.3.1節および第6.3.2節に示し、RSA公開鍵(n, e)の一部として使う公開指数eの決定方法によって区別する。第6.3.1節は指数に固定値を使い、第6.3.2節はランダム生成値を使う。第6.3節の以下の方法および第6.4節の保証について、ES(nBits)は表2または付録Dで定める、ビット長nBitsの法に対する推定最大セキュリティ強度を表す。

contents.html: 17 The 15,384-bit modulus length was not included because it is impractical to implement.
contents.html_ja: ¹⁷ 15,384ビットの法長は、実装が実用的でないため含めていない。

contents.html: 6.3.1 RSAKPG1 Family: RSA Key-Pair Generation with a Fixed Public Exponent
contents.html_ja: 6.3.1 RSAKPG1ファミリー：固定公開指数によるRSA鍵ペア生成

contents.html: The RSAKPG1 family of key-pair generation methods consists of three RSA key-pair generators where the public exponent has a fixed value (see Section 6.2). Three representations are addressed:
contents.html_ja: RSAKPG1ファミリーの鍵ペア生成方法は、公開指数を固定値とする3種類のRSA鍵ペア生成器から成る（第6.2節参照）。次の3形式を扱う。

contents.html: rsakpg1-basic generates the private key in the basic format (n, d);
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-basicは基本形式(n, d)の秘密鍵を生成する。

contents.html: rsakpg1-prime-factor generates the private key in the prime-factor format (p, q, d); and
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-prime-factorは素因数形式(p, q, d)の秘密鍵を生成する。

contents.html: rsakpg1-crt generates the private key in the Chinese Remainder Theorem format (n, e, d, p, q, dP, dQ, qInv).
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-crtは中国剰余定理形式(n, e, d, p, q, dP, dQ, qInv)の秘密鍵を生成する。

contents.html: An implementation may perform a key-pair validation before the key pair is output from the generator. The key-pair validation methods for this family are specified in Section 6.4.1.2.
contents.html_ja: 実装は、生成器から鍵ペアを出力する前に鍵ペア検証を行ってもよい。このファミリーの鍵ペア検証方法は第6.4.1.2節に規定する。

contents.html: 6.3.1.1 rsakpg1-basic
contents.html_ja: 6.3.1.1 rsakpg1-basic

contents.html: rsakpg1-basic is the generator in the RSAKPG1 family where the private key is in the basic format (n, d).
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-basicは、秘密鍵が基本形式(n, d)であるRSAKPG1ファミリーの生成器である。

contents.html: Function call: rsakpg1-basic(s, nBits, e) Input:
contents.html_ja: 関数呼出し：rsakpg1-basic(s, nBits, e)　入力：

contents.html: s: the targeted security strength;
contents.html_ja: s：目標セキュリティ強度。

contents.html: nBits: the intended bit length of the RSA modulus; and
contents.html_ja: nBits：RSA法の意図するビット長。

contents.html: e: a pre-determined public exponent − an odd integer, such that 65,537 ≤ e < 2256.
contents.html_ja: e：事前に決定する公開指数。65,537 ≤ e < 2^256を満たす奇整数。

contents.html: Process:
contents.html_ja: 処理：

contents.html: Check the values:
contents.html_ja: 値を確認する。

contents.html: a. If s is not in the range [112, 256], output an indication that the targeted security strength is not acceptable, and exit without further processing. b. If s > ES(nBits), output an indication that the modulus length is not adequate for the targeted security strength, and exit without further processing. c. If e is not an odd integer such that 65,537 ≤ e < 2256, output an indication that the exponent is out of range, and exit without further processing.
contents.html_ja: a. sが[112, 256]の範囲外の場合、目標セキュリティ強度が許容されないことを示す情報を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。b. s > ES(nBits)の場合、法長が目標セキュリティ強度に不十分であることを示す情報を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。c. eが65,537 ≤ e < 2^256を満たす奇整数でない場合、指数が範囲外であることを示す情報を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。

contents.html: Generate the prime factors p and q, as specified in FIPS 186. Note that the routines ensure that p – 1 and q – 1 are relatively prime to e.
contents.html_ja: FIPS 186に従って素因数pとqを生成する。これらのルーチンはp−1およびq−1がeと互いに素であることを保証する。

contents.html: Determine the private exponent d: d = e–1 mod LCM(p – 1, q – 1) .
contents.html_ja: 秘密指数dを決定する：d = e⁻¹ mod LCM(p−1, q−1)。

contents.html: In the very rare event that d ≤ 2nBits/2, discard the results of all computations and repeat the process, starting at step 2.
contents.html_ja: 極めてまれにd ≤ 2^(nBits/2)となる場合は、すべての計算結果を破棄し、手順2から処理を繰り返す。

contents.html: Determine the modulus n as n = p × q, the product of p and q.
contents.html_ja: 法nをpとqの積として決定する：n = p × q。

contents.html: Perform a pair-wise consistency test18 by verifying that m is the same as (me)d mod n for some integer m satisfying 1 < m < (n − 1). If an inconsistency is found, output an indication of a pair-wise consistency failure, and exit without further processing.
contents.html_ja: ある整数m（1 < m < n−1）についてmと(me)^d mod nが等しいことを検証し、ペアワイズ整合性試験¹⁸を行う。不整合が見つかった場合、ペアワイズ整合性失敗を示す情報を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。

contents.html: Output (n, e) as the public key, and (n, d) as the private key.
contents.html_ja: (n, e)を公開鍵、(n, d)を秘密鍵として出力する。

contents.html: Output:
contents.html_ja: 出力：

contents.html: (n, e): the RSA public key, and
contents.html_ja: (n, e)：RSA公開鍵。

contents.html: (n, d): the RSA private key in the basic format.
contents.html_ja: (n, d)：基本形式のRSA秘密鍵。

contents.html: Errors: Indications of the following:
contents.html_ja: エラー：次の状態を示す。

contents.html: The targeted security strength is not acceptable,
contents.html_ja: 目標セキュリティ強度が許容されない。

contents.html: The intended modulus bit length is not adequate for the targeted security strength,
contents.html_ja: 意図する法のビット長が目標セキュリティ強度に不十分。

contents.html: The fixed public exponent is out of range, or
contents.html_ja: 固定公開指数が範囲外。

contents.html: Pair-wise consistency failure.
contents.html_ja: ペアワイズ整合性試験の失敗。

contents.html: Note that key-pair validation, as specified in Section 6.4.1.2.1, can be performed after step 5 and before step 6 of the process above. If an error is detected during the validation process, output an indication of a key-pair validation failure, and exit without further processing.
contents.html_ja: 上記の処理の手順5の後、手順6の前に、第6.4.1.2.1節の鍵ペア検証を行ってもよい。検証中にエラーを検出した場合、鍵ペア検証失敗を示す情報を出力し、それ以上処理せず終了する。

contents.html: A routine that implements this generation function shall destroy any local copies of p, q, and d, as well as any other locally stored values used or produced during the execution of the routine. The destruction of these locally stored values shall occur prior to or during any exit from the routine (whether exiting early because of an error, or exiting normally with the output of an RSA key pair). Note that the requirement for destruction includes any locally stored portions of the output key pair.
contents.html_ja: この生成関数を実装するルーチンは、p、q、dのローカルコピー、および実行中に使用または生成したその他のローカル保存値を破棄しなければならない。エラーによる早期終了でも、RSA鍵ペアを出力する正常終了でも、ルーチンの終了前または終了中に破棄する。破棄要件は出力鍵ペアのローカル保存部分にも適用される。

contents.html_ja: 6.3.1.2 rsakpg1-prime-factor

The steps are the same as in rsakpg1-basic except that processing Step 6 is replaced by the following:
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-prime-factorは、秘密鍵が素因数形式(p, q, d)であるRSAKPG1ファミリーの生成器である。関数呼出し：rsakpg1-prime-factor(s, nBits, e)。入力、出力およびエラーはrsakpg1-basic（第6.3.1.1節参照）と同じだが、秘密鍵は素因数形式(p, q, d)である。rsakpg1-basicと同じ手順を用いるが、処理手順6を次のように置き換える。

contents.html: Output (n, e) as the public key, and (p, q, d) as the private key.
contents.html_ja: (n, e)を公開鍵、(p, q, d)を秘密鍵として出力する。

If an error is detected during the validation process, output an indication of a key-pair validation failure, and exit without further processing. A routine that implements this generation function shall destroy any local copies of p, q, and d, as well as any other locally stored values used or produced during the execution of the routine. The destruction of these locally stored values shall occur prior to or during any exit from the routine (whether exiting early, because of an error, or exiting normally, with the output of an RSA key pair). Note that the requirement for destruction includes any locally stored portions of the output key pair.

contents.html_ja: 6.3.1.3 rsakpg1-crt

The steps are the same as in rsakpg1-basic except that processing steps 5 and 6 are replaced by the following:
contents.html_ja: rsakpg1-crtは、秘密鍵が中国剰余定理形式(n, e, d, p, q, dP, dQ, qInv)であるRSAKPG1ファミリーの生成器である。関数呼出し：rsakpg1-crt(s, nBits, e)。入力、出力およびエラーはrsakpg1-basic（第6.3.1.1節参照）と同じだが、秘密鍵はCRT形式である。rsakpg1-basicと同じ手順を用いるが、処理手順5と6を次のように置き換える。

contents.html: 6.4 Required Assurances
contents.html_ja: 6.4 必要な保証

contents.html: Secure key establishment depends upon the use of valid key-establishment keys. The security of key-establishment schemes also depends on limiting knowledge of the private keys to those who have been authorized to use them (i.e., their respective owners) and to the trusted third party that may have generated them.22 In addition to preventing unauthorized entities from gaining access to private keys, it is also important that owners have possession of the correct private keys. To explain the assurance requirements, some terminology needs to be defined. The owner of a key pair is the entity that is authorized to use the private key that corresponds to the owner’s public key, whether or not the owner generated the key pair. The recipient of a public key is the entity that is participating in a key-establishment transaction with the owner and obtains the owner’s public key before or during the current transaction. Prior to or during a key-establishment transaction, the participants in the transaction (i.e., parties U and V) shall obtain the appropriate assurances about the key pairs used during that transaction. The types of assurance that may be sought by one or both of the parties (U and/or V) concerning the components of a key pair (i.e., the private key and public key) are discussed in Sections 6.4.1 and 6.4.2.
contents.html_ja: 安全な鍵確立は、有効な鍵確立鍵の使用に依存する。鍵確立スキームの安全性は、秘密鍵の知識を使用権限のある者（すなわち各所有者）と、鍵を生成した可能性のある信頼できる第三者に限定することにも依存する。²²不正な主体が秘密鍵にアクセスすることを防ぐだけでなく、所有者が正しい秘密鍵を所持することも重要である。保証要件を説明するため、いくつかの用語を定義する。鍵ペア所有者は、鍵ペアを自ら生成したかどうかにかかわらず、自身の公開鍵に対応する秘密鍵を使う権限のある主体である。公開鍵受領者とは、所有者との鍵確立トランザクションに参加し、現在のトランザクションの前または実行中に所有者の公開鍵を取得する主体である。トランザクションの参加者（当事者UおよびV）は、トランザクション前または実行中に、そのトランザクションで用いる鍵ペアについて適切な保証を取得しなければならない。鍵ペア要素（秘密鍵および公開鍵）に関し、一方または両方の当事者（Uおよび／またはV）が求める保証の種類を第6.4.1節および第6.4.2節で説明する。

contents.html: 6.4.1 Assurances Required by the Key-Pair Owner
contents.html_ja: 6.4.1 鍵ペア所有者に必要な保証

contents.html: Prior to the use of a key pair in a key-establishment transaction, the key-pair owner shall have assurance of the validity of the key pair. Assurance of key-pair validity provides assurance that a key pair was generated in accordance with the requirements in Sections 6.2 and 6.3. Key-pair validity implies public-key validity and assurance of possession of the correct private key. Assurance of key-pair validity can only be provided by an entity that has the private key (e.g., the owner). Depending on an organization’s requirements, a renewal of key-pair validity may be prudent. The method of obtaining initial and renewed assurance of key-pair validity is addressed in Section 6.4.1.1. Assurance of key-pair validity can be renewed at any time (see Section 6.4.1.1). As time passes, an owner may lose possession of the correct value of the private-key component of their key pair, e.g., due to an error; for this reason, renewed (i.e., current) assurance of possession of a private key can be of value for some applications. See Section 6.4.1.5 for techniques that the owner can use to obtain renewed assurance of private-key possession separately from assurance of key-pair validity.
contents.html_ja: 鍵ペア所有者は、鍵確立トランザクションで鍵ペアを使用する前に、その鍵ペアの妥当性の保証を得なければならない。妥当性の保証は、第6.2節および第6.3節の要件に従って鍵ペアが生成されたことを保証する。鍵ペアの妥当性には、公開鍵の妥当性および正しい秘密鍵の所持の保証が含まれる。鍵ペア妥当性の保証を提供できるのは秘密鍵を持つ主体（例えば所有者）に限る。組織の要件によっては、鍵ペア妥当性の再確認が適切な場合がある。初回および更新後の保証を取得する方法は第6.4.1.1節で扱う。鍵ペア妥当性はいつでも更新できる（同節参照）。時間の経過やエラーなどにより、所有者が鍵ペアの秘密鍵要素の正しい値を保持できなくなる場合がある。このため、アプリケーションによっては秘密鍵所持について更新された（最新の）保証が有用である。鍵ペア妥当性の保証とは別に、秘密鍵所持の保証を更新する技法は第6.4.1.5節を参照。

contents.html: 6.4.2.2 Partial Public-Key Validation for RSA
contents.html_ja: 6.4.2.2 RSA公開鍵の部分検証

contents.html: Partial public-key validation for RSA consists of conducting plausibility tests. These tests determine whether the public modulus and public exponent are plausible, not necessarily whether they are completely valid, i.e., they may not conform to all RSA key-generation requirements as specified in this Recommendation. Plausibility tests can detect unintentional errors with a reasonable probability. Note that full RSA public-key validation is not specified in this Recommendation, as it is an area of ongoing research. Therefore, if an application requires assurance of full public-key validation, then another approved key-establishment method shall be used (e.g., as specified in SP 800-56A). Plausibility tests shall include the tests specified in Section 5.3.3 of SP 800-89, with the caveat that the bit length of the modulus shall be a length that is approved in this Recommendation.
contents.html_ja: RSA公開鍵の部分検証は、もっともらしさ試験の実施から成る。これらの試験は公開法と公開指数がもっともらしいかを判定するものであり、完全に有効であることを必ずしも判定しない。すなわち、本勧告のRSA鍵生成要件すべてに適合しない場合もある。もっともらしさ試験は、一定の確率で意図しない誤りを検出できる。本勧告では完全なRSA公開鍵検証を規定しない。これは現在も研究中の分野である。したがって、アプリケーションが完全な公開鍵検証の保証を必要とする場合、他の承認済み鍵確立方法（SP 800-56Aなど）を使用しなければならない。もっともらしさ試験には、法のビット長が本勧告で承認された長さであるという条件を付し、SP 800-89第5.3.3節に規定する試験を含めなければならない。

contents.html: 6.4.2.3 Recipient Assurances of an Owner’s Possession of a Private Key
contents.html_ja: 6.4.2.3 公開鍵受領者が得る所有者の秘密鍵所持保証

contents.html: When two parties engage in a key-establishment transaction, there is (at least) an implicit claim of ownership made whenever a public key is provided on behalf of a particular party. That party is considered to be a claimed owner of the corresponding key pair – as opposed to being a true owner – until adequate assurance can be provided that the party is actually the one authorized to use the private key. The claimed owner can provide such assurance by demonstrating its knowledge of that private key. The recipient of another party’s public key shall obtain an initial assurance that the other party (i.e., the claimed owner of the public key) actually possesses the associated private key, either prior to or concurrently with performing a key-establishment transaction with that other party. Obtaining this assurance is addressed in Sections 6.4.2.3.1 and 6.4.2.3.2. As time passes, renewing the assurance of possession may be appropriate for some applications; assurance of possession can be renewed as specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2. A discussion of the effect of time on the assurance of private-key possession is provided in SP 800-89. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf should determine which of the methods for obtaining assurance of possession meet their security requirements. The application tasked with performing key establishment on behalf of a party should determine whether or not to proceed with a key-establishment transaction, based upon the perceived adequacy of the method(s) used. Such knowledge may be explicitly provided to the application in some manner, or may be implicitly provided by the operation of the application itself. If a binding authority is the public-key recipient: At the time of binding an owner’s identifier to his public key, the binding authority (i.e., a trusted third party, such as a CA) shall obtain assurance that the owner is in possession of the correct private key. This assurance shall either be obtained using one of the methods specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2 (e.g., with the binding authority acting as the public-key recipient) or by using an approved alternative (see SP 800-57, Part 1, Sections 5.2 and 8.1.5.1.1.2). Recipients not acting in the role of a binding authority: The recipients shall obtain this assurance either through a trusted third party (see Section 6.4.2.3.1) or directly from the owner (i.e., the other party) (see Section 6.4.2.3.2) before using the derived keying material for purposes beyond those required during the key-establishment transaction itself. If the recipient chooses to obtain this assurance directly from the other party (i.e., the claimed owner of that public key), then to comply with this Recommendation, the recipient shall use one of the methods specified in Section 6.4.2.3.2. Note that the requirement that assurance of possession be obtained before using the established keying material for purposes beyond those of the key-establishment transaction itself does not prohibit the parties to a key-establishment transaction from using a portion of the derived or transported keying material during the key-establishment transaction for purposes required by that key-establishment scheme. For example, in a transaction involving a key-agreement scheme that incorporates key confirmation, the parties establish a (purported) shared secret, derive keying material, and − as part of that same transaction − use a portion of the derived keying material as the MAC key in their key-confirmation computations.
contents.html_ja: 2者が鍵確立トランザクションを行うとき、特定の当事者に代わって公開鍵が提供される場合、少なくとも暗黙に所有権が主張される。その当事者が秘密鍵を使用する権限を実際に持つという十分な保証が得られるまでは、真の所有者ではなく当該鍵ペアの「主張された所有者」とみなす。主張された所有者は秘密鍵を知っていることを示して保証を提供できる。公開鍵受領者は、他方の当事者（公開鍵の主張された所有者）と鍵確立トランザクションを実施する前または同時に、相手が対応する秘密鍵を実際に所持する初回保証を得なければならない。取得方法は第6.4.2.3.1節および第6.4.2.3.2節に示す。アプリケーションによっては、所持保証の更新が適切な場合があり、第6.4.2.3.2節に従って更新できる。秘密鍵所持保証への時間の影響はSP 800-89参照。本勧告の適切な実装の一環として、システム利用者および／またはその信頼された代理人は、所持保証を取得する方法のうち、どれがセキュリティ要件を満たすかを判断するべきである。主体に代わって鍵確立を行うアプリケーションは、使用方法の十分性に関する認識に基づき、トランザクションを進めるか否かを決めるべきである。この情報は明示的にアプリケーションへ提供してもよく、アプリケーション自体の動作から暗黙的に得られてもよい。結合機関が公開鍵受領者である場合：所有者識別子を公開鍵に結び付ける時点で、結合機関（CAなどの信頼できる第三者）は、所有者が正しい秘密鍵を所持する保証を取得しなければならない。この保証は、第6.4.2.3.2節の方法（例えば結合機関自身が公開鍵受領者として動作）または承認済み代替手段（SP 800-57 Part 1第5.2節および第8.1.5.1.1.2節参照）で得なければならない。結合機関の役割を持たない受領者：鍵確立トランザクション自体で必要な目的を超えて導出鍵素材を使用する前に、信頼できる第三者（第6.4.2.3.1節）または所有者（すなわち他方の当事者）から直接（第6.4.2.3.2節）保証を得なければならない。所有者から直接得る場合、本勧告への適合には第6.4.2.3.2節の方法を使用しなければならない。確立した鍵素材をトランザクション外の目的に使う前に所持保証を得るという要件は、スキーム自体が求める目的で、トランザクション中に導出／転送鍵素材の一部を使うことを禁じるものではない。例えば、鍵確認付き鍵合意スキームでは、当事者は（とされる）共有秘密を確立し、鍵素材を導出した後、同じトランザクションの一部として鍵確認計算用MAC鍵に導出鍵素材の一部を使用する。

contents.html: 6.4.2.3.1 Recipient Obtains Assurance from a Trusted Third Party
contents.html_ja: 6.4.2.3.1 受領者が信頼できる第三者から保証を取得

contents.html: The recipient of a public key may receive assurance that its owner (i.e., the other party in the key-establishment transaction) is in possession of the correct private key from a trusted third party (trusted by the recipient), either before or during a key-establishment transaction that makes use of that public key. The methods used by a third party trusted by the recipient to obtain that assurance are beyond the scope of this Recommendation (see however, the discussions in Sections 6.4.2.3.2 below and in 8.1.5.1.1.2 of SP 800-57). The recipient of a public key (or agents trusted to act on behalf of the recipient) should know the method(s) used by the third party, in order to determine that the assurance obtained on behalf of the recipient is sufficient and appropriate to meet the security requirements of the recipient’s intended application(s).
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵受領者は、その公開鍵を用いる鍵確立トランザクションの前または実行中に、所有者（すなわち鍵確立トランザクションの相手）が正しい秘密鍵を所持する保証を、受領者が信頼する第三者から受け取ってもよい。第三者がその保証を得る方法は本勧告の範囲外である（ただし第6.4.2.3.2節およびSP 800-57第8.1.5.1.1.2節の説明を参照）。受領者（またはその代理として行動する信頼された者）は、受領者の意図するアプリケーションの要件を満たす十分かつ適切な保証が代理取得されたと判断できるよう、第三者が用いた方法を知っているべきである。

contents.html: 6.4.2.3.2 Recipient Obtains Assurance Directly from the Claimed Owner (i.e., the Other
contents.html_ja: 6.4.2.3.2 主張された所有者（他方の

contents.html: Party)
contents.html_ja: 当事者）から受領者が直接保証を取得

contents.html: The recipient of a public key can directly obtain assurance of the claimed owner’s current possession of the corresponding private key by successfully completing a key-establishment transaction that explicitly incorporates key confirmation, with the claimed owner serving as the key-confirmation provider. Note that the recipient of the public key in question will also be the key-confirmation recipient. Also note that this use of key confirmation is an additional benefit beyond its use to confirm that two parties possess the same keying material. There are several key-establishment schemes specified in this Recommendation that can be used. In order to claim conformance with this Recommendation, the key-establishment transaction during which the recipient of a public key seeks to obtain assurance of its owner’s current possession of the corresponding private key shall employ one of the following approved key-establishment schemes:
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵受領者は、主張された所有者を鍵確認提供者とする明示的な鍵確認を組み込んだ鍵確立トランザクションを正常に完了することで、主張された所有者が対応する秘密鍵を現在所持している保証を直接取得できる。対象公開鍵の受領者は鍵確認受領者も兼ねる。この鍵確認は、2者が同一の鍵素材を持つことの確認に加えて得られる利点でもある。本勧告で規定する複数の鍵確立スキームを使用できる。本勧告への適合を主張するには、公開鍵受領者が所有者による対応秘密鍵の現在の所持保証を取得する鍵確立トランザクションで、次の承認済みスキームのいずれかを用いなければならない。

contents.html: The KAS1-Party_V-confirmation scheme in Section 8.2.3.2 can be used to provide assurance to party U that party V possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey , (the V public key that was associated with party V when that key pair is used during the key-agreement transaction).
contents.html_ja: 第8.2.3.2節のKAS1-Party_V-confirmationスキームは、当事者Uに対し、当事者VがPubKey_Vに対応する秘密鍵（当該鍵ペアが鍵合意トランザクションで使用された際にVに関連付けられた公開鍵）を所持する保証を提供できる。

contents.html: The KAS2-Party_V-confirmation scheme in Section 8.3.3.2 can be used to provide assurance to party U that party V possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey (the V public key that was associated with party V when that key pair is used during the key-agreement transaction).
contents.html_ja: 第8.3.3.2節のKAS2-Party_V-confirmationスキームは、当事者Uに対し、当事者VがPubKey_Vに対応する秘密鍵（鍵合意トランザクションで使用された鍵ペアのVの公開鍵）を所持する保証を提供できる。

contents.html: The KAS2-Party_U-confirmation scheme in Section 8.3.3.3 can be used to provide assurance to party V that party U possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey (the U public key that was associated with party U when that key pair is used during the key-agreement transaction).
contents.html_ja: 第8.3.3.3節のKAS2-Party_U-confirmationスキームは、当事者Vに対し、当事者UがPubKey_Uに対応する秘密鍵（鍵合意トランザクションで使用された鍵ペアのUの公開鍵）を所持する保証を提供できる。

contents.html: The KAS2-bilateral-confirmation scheme in Section 8.3.3.4 can be used to provide assurance to each party that the other party possesses the correct private key that corresponds to the other party's public key; i.e., when bilateral key-confirmation is successful, party U obtains assurance that party V possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey (the key pair that was associated with party V and that was used during the V key-agreement transaction), and party V obtains assurance that party U possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey (the key pair that was associated with party U and U that was used during the key-agreement transaction).
contents.html_ja: 第8.3.3.4節のKAS2-bilateral-confirmationスキームは、相手が相手の公開鍵に対応する正しい秘密鍵を持つ保証を各当事者に提供できる。双方向鍵確認の成功時、UはVがPubKey_Vに対応する秘密鍵を持ち、VはUがPubKey_Uに対応する秘密鍵を持つ保証を得る。各公開鍵はそれぞれの当事者に関連付けられ、鍵合意トランザクションで使用された鍵ペアのものである。

contents.html: The KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme in Section 9.2.4.2 can be used to provide assurance to party U (the key-transport sender) that party V (the key-transport receiver) possesses the private key corresponding to PubKey (the key pair that was associated with V party V and that was used during the key-agreement transaction).
contents.html_ja: 第9.2.4.2節のKTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmationスキームは、当事者U（鍵転送送信者）に対し、当事者V（鍵転送受信者）がPubKey_Vに対応する秘密鍵を所持する保証を提供できる。これは鍵合意トランザクションで用いたとされる鍵ペアである。

contents.html: The recipient of a public key (or agents trusted to act on the recipient’s behalf) shall determine whether or not using one of the key-establishment schemes in this Recommendation to obtain assurance of possession through key confirmation is sufficient and appropriate to meet the security requirements of the recipient’s intended application(s). Other approved methods (e.g., see Section 5.4.4 of SP 800-57-Part 1) of directly obtaining this assurance of possession from the owner are also allowed. If obtaining assurance of possession directly from the owner is not acceptable, then assurance of possession shall be obtained indirectly as discussed in Section 6.4.2.3.1. Successful key confirmation (performed in the context described in this Recommendation) demonstrates that the correct private key has been used in the key-confirmation provider’s calculations, and thus also provides assurance that the claimed owner is the true owner. The assurance of possession obtained via the key-confirmation schemes identified above may be useful even when the recipient has previously obtained independent assurance that the claimed owner of a public key is indeed its true owner. This may be appropriate in situations where the recipient desires renewed assurance that the owner possesses the correct private key (and that the owner is still able to use it correctly), including situations where there is no access to a trusted party who can provide renewed assurance of the owner’s continued possession of the private key.
contents.html_ja: 公開鍵受領者（またはその代理として行動する信頼された者）は、本勧告の鍵確立スキームによる鍵確認を用いて所持保証を取得する方法が、受領者の意図するアプリケーションのセキュリティ要件を満たすのに十分かつ適切かを判断しなければならない。所有者から直接所持保証を取得する他の承認済み方法（SP 800-57 Part 1第5.4.4節参照）も許される。所有者から直接取得することが許容されない場合、第6.4.2.3.1節のとおり間接的に取得しなければならない。本勧告で説明する文脈で実施する鍵確認が成功すれば、鍵確認提供者の計算で正しい秘密鍵が使われたことが示され、主張された所有者が真の所有者である保証も得られる。受領者が既に独立に所有者の真正性を保証されている場合にも、上記スキームによる所持保証は有用な場合がある。秘密鍵を正しく所持し引き続き正しく使用できることの更新保証を望む場合や、所持保証を更新できる信頼された当事者にアクセスできない場合などに適切である。

contents.html: RSAEP and RSADP are the basic encryption and decryption primitives from the RSA cryptosystem [RSA 1978] specified in PKCS 1. RSAEP produces ciphertext from plaintext using a public key; RSADP recovers the plaintext from the ciphertext using the corresponding private key. The primitives assume that the RSA public key is valid.

contents.html_ja: 7.1.2 RSADP

contents.html: RSADP is the decryption primitive. It recovers the plaintext from ciphertext using an RSA private key. The format of the decryption operation depends on the format of the private key: basic, prime factor or CRT. A routine that implements this primitive shall destroy any local copies of the private key, as well as any other potentially sensitive locally stored values used or produced during the execution of the routine (such as any locally stored portions of the plaintext). The destruction of these values shall occur prior to or during any exit from the routine (whether exiting early because of an error or exiting normally, with the output of plaintext).
contents.html_ja: RSADPは復号プリミティブであり、RSA秘密鍵を用いて暗号文から平文を復元する。復号操作の形式は秘密鍵の基本、素因数またはCRT形式によって異なる。このプリミティブを実装するルーチンは秘密鍵のローカルコピーと、実行中に使用または生成したその他の機微な可能性のあるローカル保存値（平文のローカル保存部分など）を破棄しなければならない。エラーによる早期終了または平文出力の正常終了のいずれでも、終了前または終了中に破棄する。

contents.html: Note: Care should be taken to ensure that an implementation of RSADP does not reveal even partial information about the value of the plaintext to unauthorized entities. An opponent who can reliably obtain particular bits of the plaintext for sufficiently many chosen ciphertext values may be able to obtain the full decryption of an arbitrary ciphertext by applying the bit-security results of Håstad and Näslund [HN 1998].

contents.html: 7.2 Encryption and Decryption Operations
contents.html_ja: 7.2 暗号化および復号操作

contents.html: 7.2.1 RSA Secret-Value Encapsulation (RSASVE)
contents.html_ja: 7.2.1 RSA秘密値カプセル化（RSASVE）

contents.html: The RSASVE generate operation is used by one party in a key-establishment transaction to generate and encrypt a secret value to produce ciphertext using the public key-establishment key of the other party. When this ciphertext is received by that other party, and the secret value is recovered (using the RSASVE recover operation and the corresponding private key-establishment key), the secret value is then considered to be a shared secret. Secret-value encapsulation employs a Random Bit Generator (RBG) to generate the secret value. The RSASVE generate and recovery operations specified in Sections 7.2.1.2 and 7.2.1.3, respectively, are based on the RSAEP and RSADP primitives (see Section 7.1). These operations are used by the KAS1 and KAS2 key-agreement families (see Sections 8.2 and 8.3).

contents.html: 7.2.2 RSA with Optimal Asymmetric Encryption Padding (RSA-OAEP)
contents.html_ja: 7.2.2 最適非対称暗号化パディングを用いるRSA（RSA-OAEP）

contents.html: RSA-OAEP consists of asymmetric encryption and decryption operations that are based on an approved hash function, an approved random bit generator, a mask-generation function, and the RSAEP and RSADP primitives. These operations are used by the KTS-OAEP key-transport scheme (see Section 9.2). In the RSA-OAEP encryption operation, a data block is constructed by the sender (party U) from the keying material to be transported and the hash of additional input (see Section 9.1) that is shared by party U and the intended receiving party (party V). A random byte string is generated, after which both the random byte string and the data block are masked in a way that binds their values. The masked values are used to form the plaintext that is input to the RSAEP primitive, along with the public key-establishment key of party V. The resulting RSAEP output further binds the random byte string, the keying material and the hash of the additional data in the ciphertext that is sent to party V. In the RSA-OAEP decryption operation, the ciphertext and the receiving party’s (i.e., party V’s) private key-establishment key are input to the RSADP primitive, recovering the masked values as output. The mask-generation function is then used to reconstruct and remove the masks that obscure the random byte string and the data block. After removing the masks, party V can examine the format of the recovered data and compare its own computation of the hash of the additional data to the hash value contained in the unmasked data block, thus obtaining some measure of assurance of the integrity of the recovered data – including the transported keying material. RSA-OAEP can process up to nLen – 2HLen – 2 bytes of keying material, where nLen is the byte length of the recipient’s RSA modulus, and HLen is the byte length of the values output by the underlying hash function.
contents.html_ja: RSA-OAEPは、承認済みハッシュ関数、承認済み乱数ビット生成器、マスク生成関数、およびRSAEP／RSADPプリミティブに基づく非対称暗号化・復号操作から成る。これらの操作はKTS-OAEP鍵転送スキームで用いる（第9.2節参照）。RSA-OAEP暗号化操作では、送信者（当事者U）が転送対象の鍵素材と、Uおよび意図する受信者（当事者V）が共有する追加入力（第9.1節参照）のハッシュからデータブロックを構成する。ランダムバイト文字列を生成した後、そのランダム文字列とデータブロックの値を結び付ける方法で双方をマスクする。マスク済み値から平文を構成し、当事者Vの公開鍵確立鍵とともにRSAEPプリミティブへ入力する。RSAEP出力により、ランダム文字列、鍵素材および追加入力のハッシュがさらに結び付けられ、当事者Vに送る暗号文となる。RSA-OAEP復号操作では、暗号文と受信者（当事者V）の秘密鍵確立鍵をRSADPプリミティブへ入力し、マスク済み値を出力として復元する。続いてマスク生成関数で、ランダムバイト文字列とデータブロックを隠すマスクを再構成して除去する。マスク除去後、当事者Vは復元データの形式を検査し、追加入力のハッシュを自ら計算した値と、マスク解除済みデータブロックに含まれるハッシュ値を比較できる。これにより、転送鍵素材を含む復元データの完全性について一定の保証を得る。RSA-OAEPは最大nLen − 2HLen − 2バイトの鍵素材を処理できる。nLenは受信者のRSA法のバイト長、HLenは基礎ハッシュ関数が出力する値のバイト長である。

contents.html: 8 Key-Agreement Schemes

contents.html: In a key-agreement scheme, two parties, party U and party V, establish keying material over which neither has complete control of the result, but both have influence. This Recommendation provides two families of key-agreement schemes: KAS1 and KAS2. The KAS1 family consists of the KAS1-basic and KAS1-Party_V-confirmation schemes, and the KAS2 family consists of the KAS2-basic, KAS2-Party_V-confirmation, KAS2-Party_U-confirmation, and KAS2-bilateral-confirmation schemes. These schemes are based on secret-value encapsulation (see Section 7.2.1). Key confirmation is included in some of these schemes to provide assurance that the participants share the same keying material; see Section 5.6 for the details of key confirmation. When possible, each party should have such assurance. Although other methods are often used to provide this assurance, this Recommendation makes no statement as to the adequacy of these other methods. Key confirmation may also provide assurance of private-key possession. For each of the KAS1 and KAS2 schemes, Party V shall have an identifier, ID , that has an
contents.html_ja: 鍵合意スキームでは、当事者UとVの2者が、結果をどちらも完全には制御できないが双方が影響を与える鍵素材を確立する。本勧告はKAS1およびKAS2の2ファミリーを規定する。KAS1ファミリーはKAS1-basicおよびKAS1-Party_V-confirmationから成り、KAS2ファミリーはKAS2-basic、KAS2-Party_V-confirmation、KAS2-Party_U-confirmation、KAS2-bilateral-confirmationから成る。これらのスキームは秘密値カプセル化（第7.2.1節参照）に基づく。一部のスキームには、参加者が同じ鍵素材を共有する保証を与えるため鍵確認を含む。詳細は第5.6節参照。可能な場合、各当事者はその保証を得るべきである。他の方法で保証を提供することも多いが、本勧告はそれらの適切性を判断しない。鍵確認は秘密鍵所持の保証も提供する場合がある。KAS1およびKAS2の各スキームで、当事者Vは識別子ID_Vを持たなければならず、その識別子は既知または発見可能であり、当事者Uから信頼される鍵ペアとの

contents.html: A general flow diagram is provided for each key-agreement scheme. The dotted-line arrows represent the distribution of public keys by the parties themselves or by a third party, such as a Certification Authority (CA). The solid-line arrows represent the distribution of nonces or cryptographically protected values that occur during the key-agreement scheme. Note that the flow diagrams in this Recommendation omit explicit mention of various validation checks that are required. The flow diagrams and descriptions in this Recommendation assume a successful completion of the key-agreement process. For each scheme, there are conditions that must be satisfied to enable proper use of that scheme. These conditions are listed as assumptions. Failure to meet all such conditions could yield undesirable results, such as the inability to communicate or the loss of security. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf (including application developers, system installers, and system administrators) are responsible for ensuring that all assumptions are satisfied at the time that a key-establishment transaction takes place.

contents.html_ja: 8.1 鍵合意に共通する構成要素

contents.html: The key-agreement schemes in this Recommendation have the following common components:
contents.html_ja: 本勧告の鍵合意スキームには次の共通構成要素がある。

contents.html: RSASVE: RSA secret-value encapsulation, consisting of a generation operation RSASVE.GENERATE and a recovery operation RSASVE.RECOVER (see Section 7.2.1).
contents.html_ja: RSASVE：RSA秘密値カプセル化。RSASVE.GENERATE生成操作およびRSASVE.RECOVER復元操作から成る（第7.2.1節参照）。

contents.html: KDM: A key-derivation method (see Section 5.5).
contents.html_ja: KDM：鍵導出方法（第5.5節参照）。

contents.html: 8.2 KAS1 Key Agreement
contents.html_ja: 8.2 KAS1鍵合意

contents.html: For the KAS1 key-agreement schemes, even if both parties have key-establishment key pairs, only party V’s key-establishment key pair is used. The KAS1 key-agreement schemes have the following general form:
contents.html_ja: KAS1鍵合意スキームでは、双方が鍵確立鍵ペアを持っていても、当事者Vの鍵確立鍵ペアだけを使う。KAS1鍵合意スキームの一般形は次のとおり。

contents.html: Party U generates a secret value (which will become a shared secret) and a corresponding ciphertext using the RSASVE.GENERATE operation and party V’s public key-establishment key, and then sends the ciphertext to party V.
contents.html_ja: 当事者UはRSASVE.GENERATE操作と当事者Vの公開鍵確立鍵を用いて秘密値（共有秘密となる）および対応する暗号文を生成し、その暗号文を当事者Vに送る。

contents.html: Party V recovers the secret value from the ciphertext using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key; the secret value is then considered to be the shared secret. Party V generates a nonce and sends it to party U.

contents.html: Party V recovers party U’s secret component from the ciphertext received from party U using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key.
contents.html_ja: 当事者VはRSASVE.RECOVER操作と自身の秘密鍵確立鍵を用い、Uから受信した暗号文からUの秘密成分を復元する。

contents.html: Party V generates a secret value (which will become a second component of the shared secret) and the corresponding ciphertext using the RSASVE.GENERATE operation and party U’s public key-establishment key, and sends the ciphertext to party U.
contents.html_ja: 当事者VはRSASVE.GENERATE操作と当事者Uの公開鍵確立鍵を用いて、共有秘密の第2の成分となる秘密値および対応する暗号文を生成し、暗号文をUに送る。

contents.html: Party U recovers party V’s secret component from the ciphertext received from party V using the RSASVE.RECOVER operation and its private key-establishment key.
contents.html_ja: 当事者UはRSASVE.RECOVER操作と自身の秘密鍵確立鍵を用い、Vから受信した暗号文からVの秘密成分を復元する。

contents.html: Both parties concatenate the two secret components to form the shared secret, and then derive keying material from the shared secret and “other information” using a key-derivation method. The length of the keying material that can be agreed on is limited only by the length that can be output by the key-derivation method.
contents.html_ja: 双方は2つの秘密成分を連結して共有秘密を形成し、鍵導出方法を用いて共有秘密と「その他の情報」から鍵素材を導出する。合意可能な鍵素材の長さは鍵導出方法が出力できる長さによってのみ制限される。

contents.html: Party U and/or party V may additionally provide key confirmation. If key confirmation is incorporated, then the derived keying material is parsed into two parts, MacKey and KeyData. MacKey is then used to compute a MAC tag of MacTagLen bytes on MacData (see Sections 5.2.1, 5.2.2, 5.6.1 and 5.6.3). Key confirmation may be either unilateral or bilateral. When key confirmation is performed, a MacTag is sent from a KC provider to a KC recipient.
contents.html_ja: 当事者Uおよび／またはVはさらに鍵確認を提供してもよい。鍵確認を組み込む場合、導出鍵素材をMacKeyとKeyDataに分け、MacDataに対するMacTagLenバイトのMACタグを計算する（第5.2.1節、第5.2.2節、第5.6.1節および第5.6.3節参照）。鍵確認は一方向でも双方向でもよい。実施する場合、KC提供者からKC受領者にMacTagを送る。

contents.html: When unilateral key confirmation in performed: One party assumes the role of the KC provider, and the other party assumes the role of the KC recipient. If the MAC tag computed by the provider matches the MAC tag computed by the recipient, then the successful establishment of keying material is confirmed by the recipient.
contents.html_ja: 一方向鍵確認を行う場合、一方がKC提供者、他方がKC受領者となる。提供者の計算したMACタグと受領者の計算したMACタグが一致すれば、受領者は鍵素材の確立成功を確認する。

contents.html: When bilateral key confirmation is performed: The key confirmation process requires two interactions (e.g., two messages). In the first interaction, one party assumes the role of the KC provider, and the other party assumes the role of the KC recipient. In the second interaction, the roles are reversed. If each party acting as a recipient determines that the computed MAC tag matches the MAC tag provided by the other party (acting as the provider), then the successful establishment of keying material is confirmed by both parties, and each party has obtained assurance that the other party has actively participated in the transaction.
contents.html_ja: 双方向鍵確認を行う場合、鍵確認プロセスは2回のやり取り（例えば2つのメッセージ）を必要とする。1回目は一方がKC提供者、他方がKC受領者となり、2回目は役割を逆にする。受領者として動作する各当事者が計算したMACタグと他方（提供者として動作）が送ったMACタグの一致を確認すれば、双方が鍵素材の確立成功を確認し、相手がトランザクションに能動的に参加した保証を得る。

contents.html: The following schemes are defined:
contents.html_ja: 次のスキームを定義する。

contents.html: KAS2-basic, the basic scheme without key confirmation (see Section 8.3.2).
contents.html_ja: KAS2-basic：鍵確認なしの基本スキーム（第8.3.2節参照）。

contents.html: KAS2-Party_V-confirmation, a variant of KAS2-basic with unilateral key confirmation provided by party V to party U (see Section 8.3.3.2).
contents.html_ja: KAS2-Party_V-confirmation：KAS2-basicの派生であり、当事者VがUに一方向鍵確認を提供する（第8.3.3.2節参照）。

contents.html: KAS2-Party_U-confirmation, a variant of KAS2-basic with unilateral key confirmation probided by party U to party V (see Section 8.3.3.3).
contents.html_ja: KAS2-Party_U-confirmation：KAS2-basicの派生であり、当事者UがVに一方向鍵確認を提供する（第8.3.3.3節参照）。

contents.html: KAS2-bilateral-confirmation, a variant of KAS2-basic with bilateral key confirmation between party U and party V (see Section 8.3.3.4).
contents.html_ja: KAS2-bilateral-confirmation：当事者UとVの間で双方向鍵確認を行うKAS2-basicの派生（第8.3.3.4節参照）。

contents.html: For the security properties of the KAS2 key-agreement schemes, see Section 10.2.
contents.html_ja: KAS2鍵合意スキームのセキュリティ特性は第10.2節参照。

contents.html: 8.3.1 KAS2 Assumptions
contents.html_ja: 8.3.1 KAS2の仮定

contents.html: Each party has been designated as the owner of a key-establishment key pair that was generated as specified in Section 6.3. Prior to or during the key-agreement process, each party has obtained assurance of its possession of the correct value for its own private key as specified in Section 6.4.1.5.
contents.html_ja: 各当事者は、第6.3節に従って生成された鍵確立鍵ペアの所有者として指定されている。鍵合意プロセスの前または実行中に、各当事者は第6.4.1.5節に従い自身の秘密鍵の正しい値を所持する保証を取得している。

contents.html: The parties have agreed upon an approved key-derivation method (see Section 5.5), as well as an approved algorithm to be used with that method (e.g., a specific hash function) and other associated parameters to be used for key derivation.
contents.html_ja: 当事者は承認済み鍵導出方法（第5.5節参照）、その方法で用いる承認済みアルゴリズム（特定のハッシュ関数など）、および鍵導出に用いる関連パラメータに合意している。

contents.html: If key confirmation is used, party U and party V have agreed upon an approved MAC algorithm and associated parameters, including the lengths of MacKey and MacTag (see Section 5.2). The parties must also agree on whether one party or both parties will send MacTag, and in what order.
contents.html_ja: 鍵確認を用いる場合、UとVは承認済みMACアルゴリズムと関連パラメータ（MacKeyおよびMacTagの長さを含む、第5.2節参照）に合意している。どちらの当事者がMacTagを送るか、双方が送るか、またその順序にも合意しなければならない。

contents.html: When an identifier is used to label a party during the key-agreement process, that identifier has a trusted association to that party’s public key. (In other words, whenever both the identifier and public key of one participant are employed in the key-agreement process, they are associated in a manner that is trusted by the other participant.) When an identifier is used to label a party during the key-agreement process, both parties are aware of the particular identifier employed for that purpose.
contents.html_ja: 鍵合意プロセスで当事者を表す識別子を用いる場合、その識別子は当事者の公開鍵と信頼できる関連付けを持つ。（すなわち、参加者の識別子と公開鍵を双方ともプロセスで用いる場合、他方の参加者が信頼する方法で関連付けられている。）また、両当事者は使用する識別子を認識している。

contents.html: Each party has obtained assurance of the validity of the public keys that are used during the transaction, as specified in Section 6.4.2.3.
contents.html_ja: 各当事者は、第6.4.2.3節に規定するように、トランザクションで使用する公開鍵の妥当性保証を得ている。

contents.html: The following is an assumption for using any keying material derived during a KAS2 key-agreement scheme for purposes beyond those of the scheme itself.
contents.html_ja: KAS2鍵合意スキーム中に導出した鍵素材をスキーム自体の目的を超えて使用するための仮定：

contents.html: Each party has obtained (or will obtain) assurance that the other party is (or was) in possession of the private key corresponding to their public key that was used during the key-agreement transaction, as specified in Section 6.4.2.3. This assumption recognizes the possibility that assurance of private-key possession may be provided/obtained by means of key confirmation performed as part of a particular KAS2 transaction.
contents.html_ja: 各当事者は、第6.4.2.3節に従い、相手が鍵合意トランザクションで用いた公開鍵に対応する秘密鍵を所持している（または所持していた）保証を取得済みまたは取得する。この仮定は、特定のKAS2トランザクションの一部として行う鍵確認によって秘密鍵所持保証を提供／取得できる可能性を認める。

MacKey shall be the first MacKeyLen bytes of the keying material and shall be used only for the key-confirmation operation of a single transaction. For KAS2 key confirmation, the length of the keying material shall be at least MacKeyLen bytes. The keying material is usually longer than

contents.html: 9 Key-Transport Schemes
contents.html_ja: 9 鍵転送スキーム

contents.html: In a key-transport scheme, two parties, the sender and receiver, establish keying material selected by the sender. The keying material may be cryptographically bound to additional input (see Section 9.1). In this Recommendation, the KTS-OAEP family of key-transport schemes is specified (see Section 9.2). In addition, a hybrid method for key transport is discussed whereby a key-establishment scheme specified in this Recommendation is followed by a key-wrapping scheme (see Section 9.3). Key confirmation is included in one of the KTS-OAEP schemes to provide assurance to the sender that the participants share the same keying material (see Section 5.6 for further details on key confirmation). A general flow diagram is provided for each KTS-OAEP key-transport scheme. The dotted-line arrows represent the distribution of public keys by the parties themselves or by a third party, such as a Certification Authority (CA). The solid-line arrows represent the distribution of cryptographically protected values that occur during the key-transport or key-confirmation process. Note that the flow diagrams in this Recommendation omit explicit mention of various validation checks that are required. The flow diagrams and descriptions in this Recommendation assume a successful completion of the key-transport process. As in Section 8, there are conditions that must be satisfied for each key-transport scheme to enable the proper use of that scheme. These conditions are listed as assumptions. Failure to meet any of these conditions could yield undesirable results, such as the inability to communicate or the loss of security. As part of the proper implementation of this Recommendation, system users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf (including application developers, system installers, and system administrators) are responsible for ensuring that all assumptions are satisfied at the time that a key-establishment transaction takes place.
contents.html_ja: 鍵転送スキームでは、送信者と受信者の2者が、送信者が選択した鍵素材を確立する。鍵素材は追加入力に暗号学的に結び付けてもよい（第9.1節参照）。本勧告ではKTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームを規定する（第9.2節参照）。さらに、本勧告で規定する鍵確立スキームの後に鍵ラッピングスキームを用いるハイブリッド鍵転送方式を説明する（第9.3節参照）。KTS-OAEPスキームの1つには、参加者が同じ鍵素材を共有する保証を送信者に提供するため鍵確認を含める（詳細は第5.6節参照）。各KTS-OAEP鍵転送スキームに一般的なフロー図を示す。点線矢印は当事者自身またはCAなどの第三者による公開鍵配布を表す。実線矢印は鍵転送または鍵確認プロセス中に配布される暗号学的に保護された値を表す。本勧告のフロー図では、必要な各種検証確認を明記していない。図と説明は鍵転送プロセスが正常に完了することを仮定する。第8節と同様に、鍵転送スキームを適切に使用するには満たすべき条件があり、仮定として列挙する。これらの条件を満たさないと、通信不能またはセキュリティ喪失など望ましくない結果を招く可能性がある。本勧告を適切に実装するため、システム利用者および／またはその代理として行動する信頼された者（アプリケーション開発者、システム設置者、システム管理者を含む）は、鍵確立トランザクション時にすべての仮定が満たされていることを確保する責任を負う。

contents.html: 9.1 Additional Input
contents.html_ja: 9.1 追加入力

contents.html: Additional input to the key-transport process may be employed to ensure that the keying material is adequately “bound” to the context of the key-transport transaction. The use of additional input, A, is explicitly supported by the key-transport schemes specified in Section 9.2. Each party to a key-transport transaction shall know whether or not additional input is employed in that transaction. Context-specific information that may be appropriate for inclusion in the additional input is listed in Section 5.5.2. (The suggestions for the content of FixedfInfo apply to the additional input as well.) Both parties to the key-transport transaction shall know the format of the additional input, A, and shall acquire A in time to use it as required by the scheme. The methods used for formatting and distributing the additional input are application-defined. System users and/or agents trusted to act on their behalf should determine that the information selected for inclusion in A and the methods used for formatting and distributing A meet the security requirements of those users.
contents.html_ja: 鍵転送プロセスでは、鍵素材を鍵転送トランザクションのコンテキストに適切に「結び付ける」ため、追加入力を使用してもよい。第9.2節の鍵転送スキームは追加入力Aを明示的にサポートする。鍵転送トランザクションの各当事者は、そのトランザクションで追加入力を用いるか否かを把握していなければならない。追加入力に含めるのが適切なコンテキスト固有情報を第5.5.2節に列挙する（FixedInfoの内容に関する提案は追加入力にも適用される）。両当事者は追加入力Aの形式を知り、スキームの要求に応じて利用できるよう適時にAを取得しなければならない。追加入力の形式設定および配布方法はアプリケーションで定義する。システム利用者および／または信頼された代理人は、Aに含める情報とAの形式設定・配布方法がセキュリティ要件を満たすと判断するべきである。

contents.html: The KTS-OAEP family of key-transport schemes is based on the RSA-OAEP encrypt and decrypt operations (see Section 7.2.2), which are, in turn, based on the asymmetric encryption and decryption primitives, RSAEP and RSADP (see Section 7.1). In this family, only party V’s key pair is used. The key-transport schemes of this family have the following general form:
contents.html_ja: KTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームはRSA-OAEP暗号化・復号操作（第7.2.2節参照）に基づき、これらの操作は非対称暗号化・復号プリミティブRSAEPおよびRSADPに基づく（第7.1節参照）。このファミリーでは当事者Vの鍵ペアだけを用いる。スキームの一般形は次のとおり。

contents.html: Party U (the sender) encrypts the keying material (and possibly additional input – see Section 7.2.2.3) to be transported using the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation and party V’s (the receiver’s) public key-establishment key to produce ciphertext, and sends the ciphertext to party V.
contents.html_ja: 当事者U（送信者）はRSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT操作と当事者V（受信者）の公開鍵確立鍵を用いて、転送対象の鍵素材（および追加入力の場合はそれも。第7.2.2.3節参照）を暗号化して暗号文を作り、Vに送る。

contents.html: Party V decrypts the ciphertext using its private key-establishment key and the RSA-OAEP.DECRYPT operation to recover the transported keying material (see Section 7.2.2.4).
contents.html_ja: 当事者Vは自身の秘密鍵確立鍵とRSA-OAEP.DECRYPT操作で暗号文を復号し、転送された鍵素材を復元する（第7.2.2.4節参照）。

contents.html: If key confirmation is incorporated, then the transported keying material is parsed into two parts, a transaction-specific (random) value for MacKey, followed by KeyData (see Section 5.6.1). The Mackey portion of the keying material and an approved MAC algorithm are used by each party to compute a MAC tag (of an appropriate, agreed-upon length) on what should be the same MacData (see Sections 5.6 and 9.2.4.2). The MAC tag computed by party V (the key-confirmation provider) is sent to party U (the key-confirmation recipient). If the value of the MAC tag sent by party V matches the MAC tag value computed by party U, then party U obtains a confirmation of the success of the key-transport transaction.
contents.html_ja: 鍵確認を組み込む場合、転送鍵素材をトランザクション固有のランダム値MacKeyと、その後に続くKeyDataの2部分に解析する（第5.6.1節参照）。双方の当事者は鍵素材のMacKey部分と承認済みMACアルゴリズムを用い、同一であるべきMacDataに対するMACタグを合意済みの適切な長さで計算する（第5.6節および第9.2.4.2節参照）。当事者V（鍵確認提供者）が計算したMACタグを当事者U（鍵確認受領者）に送る。VのMACタグ値とUが計算した値が一致すれば、Uは鍵転送トランザクションの成功を確認する。

contents.html: 9.3 Hybrid Key-Transport Methods
contents.html_ja: 9.3 ハイブリッド鍵転送方式

contents.html: Key transport may be accomplished following any of the key-establishment schemes in this Recommendation (i.e, any KAS1, KAS2 or KTS-OAEP scheme) by using an approved key-wrapping algorithm (see SP 800-38F25) with a key-wrapping key established during the execution of that key-establishment scheme. The security properties for this hybrid key-establishment process depend on the key-establishment scheme, the key-wrapping algorithm and the communication protocol used; the roles assumed by the participants during the process; and all other parameters used during the entire process.

contents.html: 10 Rationale for Selecting a Specific Scheme
contents.html_ja: 10 特定のスキームを選ぶ根拠

contents.html: The subsections that follow describe the security properties that may be considered when a user and/or developer is choosing a key-establishment scheme from among the various schemes described in this Recommendation. The descriptions are intended to highlight certain similarities and differences between families of key-establishment schemes and/or between schemes within a particular family; they do not constitute an in-depth analysis of all possible security properties of every scheme under all adversary models. The (brief) discussions will focus on the extent to which each participant in a particular transaction has assurance that fresh keying material has been successfully established with the intended party (and no one else). To that end, it is important to distinguish between the actual identifier of a participant in a key-establishment transaction and the role (party U or party V) assumed by that participant during the transaction. To simplify matters, in what follows, assume that the actual identifiers of the (honest) participants in a key-establishment transaction are the proverbial “Alice,” acting as party U, and “Bob,” acting as party V. (Pretend, for the sake of discussion, that these identifiers are unique among the universe of possible participants.) The identifier associated with their malevolent adversary is “Eve.” The discussions will also consider the ill effects of certain compromises that might occur. The basic security properties that are cited depend on such factors as how a shared secret is calculated, how keying material is established, and what types of key-confirmation (if any) are incorporated into a given scheme. Note 1: In order to provide concise descriptions of security properties possessed by the various schemes, it is necessary to make some assumptions concerning the format and type of data that is used as input during key derivation. The following assumptions are made solely for the purposes of Sections 10.1 through 10.3; they are not intended to preclude the options specified elsewhere in this Recommendation.
contents.html_ja: 以下の小節では、本勧告で説明する複数の鍵確立スキームから利用者および／または開発者が選択する際に考慮し得るセキュリティ特性を説明する。説明は、鍵確立スキームのファミリー間または各ファミリー内のスキーム間にある特定の類似点・相違点を示すものであり、あらゆる攻撃者モデルの下ですべてのスキームの全セキュリティ特性を詳細に分析するものではない。簡潔な考察では、各トランザクションの参加者が意図した相手（他の誰でもない）と新鮮な鍵素材を正常に確立できたという保証の程度に焦点を当てる。そのため、鍵確立トランザクションの参加者の実際の識別子と、トランザクション中にその参加者が担う役割（当事者UまたはV）を区別することが重要である。簡単のため、以下では（正直な）参加者の実際の識別子を、Uとして動作する「Alice」とVとして動作する「Bob」とする（説明上、これらの識別子は参加者全体で一意と仮定する）。悪意ある攻撃者の識別子は「Eve」とする。また、発生し得る特定の侵害による悪影響も考察する。挙げる基本的セキュリティ特性は、共有秘密の計算方法、鍵素材の確立方法、スキームに組み込む鍵確認の種類（あれば）などに依存する。注1：各スキームのセキュリティ特性を簡潔に記述するため、鍵導出入力データの形式と種類について仮定が必要である。以下の仮定は第10.1節から第10.3節の目的に限って用い、本勧告の他の箇所で指定する選択肢を排除しない。

contents.html: When discussing the security properties of schemes, it is assumed that the FixedInfo input to a (single-step) key-derivation function employed during a particular key-agreement transaction uses either the concatenation format or the ASN.1 format (see Section 5.5). It is also assumed that FixedInfo includes sufficiently specific identifiers for the participants in the transaction, an identifier for the key-establishment scheme being used during the transaction, and additional input (e.g., a nonce, and/or session identifier) that may provide assurance to one or both participants that the derived keying material will reflect the specific context in which the transaction occurs (see Section 5.5 and Appendix B of SP 800-56A for further discussion concerning context-specific information that may be appropriate for inclusion in FixedInfo).

contents.html: Note 2: Different schemes may possess different security properties. A scheme should be selected based on how well the scheme fulfills system requirements. For instance, if messages are exchanged over a large-scale network where each exchange consumes a considerable amount of time, a scheme with fewer exchanges during a single key-agreement transaction might be preferable to a scheme with more exchanges, even though the latter may possess more security benefits. It is important to keep in mind that a key-establishment scheme is usually a component of a larger protocol that may offer security-related assurances beyond those that can be provided by the key-establishment scheme alone. For example, the protocol may include specific features that limit opportunities for accidental or intentional misuse of the key-establishment component of the protocol. Protocols, per se, are not specified in this Recommendation.
contents.html_ja: 注2：スキームごとにセキュリティ特性は異なり得る。スキームはシステム要件への適合度に基づいて選択するべきである。例えば、大規模ネットワーク上のメッセージ交換に多大な時間がかかる場合、単一鍵合意トランザクションで交換回数の多いスキームより、交換回数の少ないスキームが望ましいことがある。後者の方がセキュリティ上の利点を多く持つとしても同様である。鍵確立スキームは通常、より大きなプロトコルの一部であり、そのプロトコルはスキーム単独で提供できる以上のセキュリティ保証を提供することがある。例えばプロトコルには、鍵確立要素の偶発的または意図的な誤用機会を制限する機能を含み得る。本勧告はプロトコル自体を規定しない。

contents.html_ja: 10.1 KAS1鍵合意スキームを選ぶ根拠

contents.html: In both schemes included in the KAS1 family, only Bob (assumed to be acting as party V) is required to own an RSA key pair that is used in the key-agreement transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice (who is acting as party U). This can provide Alice with some level of assurance that she has correctly identified the party with whom she will be establishing keying material if the transaction is successfully completed. Each KAS1 scheme requires Alice to employ the RSASVE.GENERATE operation to select a (random) secret value Z and encrypt it as ciphertext C using Bob’s RSA public key. Unless Bob’s corresponding private key has been compromised, Alice has assurance that no unintended entity (i.e., no one but Bob) could employ the RSASVE.RECOVER operation to obtain Z from C. Absent the compromise of Bob’s RSA private key and/or Z, Alice may attain a certain level of confidence that she has correctly identified party V as Bob. Alice’s level of confidence is dependent upon:
contents.html_ja: KAS1ファミリーの両スキームでは、鍵合意トランザクションで使用するRSA鍵ペアを所有する必要があるのはBob（当事者Vと仮定）のみである。トランザクションでVを表す識別子は、Alice（当事者U）が信頼する方法でBobのRSA公開鍵に関連付けられていると仮定する。これによりトランザクションが正常完了した場合、Aliceは鍵素材を確立する相手を正しく識別したとの一定の保証を得られる。各KAS1スキームでAliceはRSASVE.GENERATE操作を使って（ランダムな）秘密値Zを選び、BobのRSA公開鍵で暗号化して暗号文Cにする必要がある。Bobの対応する秘密鍵が侵害されていなければ、Bob以外の意図しない主体がRSASVE.RECOVERを使ってCからZを得ることはできないとAliceは保証される。Bobの秘密鍵および／またはZが侵害されていなければ、AliceはVをBobと正しく識別した確信を一定程度得られる。その確信の程度は次に依存する。

contents.html: In the schemes included in the KAS2 family, both Alice (assumed to be acting as party U) and Bob (assumed to be acting as party V) are required to own an RSA key pair that is used in their key-agreement transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice. Similarly, assume that the identifier used to label party U during the transaction is one that is associated with Alice’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Bob. This can provide each party with some level of assurance concerning the identifier of the other party, with whom keying material will be established if the transaction is successfully completed. contents.html: In each of the key-transport schemes included in the KTS-OAEP family, only Bob (assumed to be acting as party V, the key-transport receiver) is required to own an RSA key pair that is used in the transaction. Assume that the identifier used to label party V during the transaction is one that is associated with Bob’s RSA public key in a manner that is trusted by Alice (who is acting as party U, the key-transport sender). This can provide Alice with some level of assurance that she has correctly identified the party with whom she will be establishing keying material if the key-transport transaction is successfully completed.

contents.html: Each KTS-OAEP scheme requires Alice to employ the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation to encrypt the selected keying material (and any additional input) as ciphertext C, using Bob’s RSA public key. Unless Bob’s corresponding private key has been compromised, Alice has assurance that no unintended entity (i.e., no one but Bob) could employ the RSA-OAEP.DECRYPT operation to obtain the transported keying material from C. Absent the compromise of Bob’s RSA private key (or some compromise of the keying material itself – perhaps prior to transport), Alice may attain a certain level of confidence that she has correctly identified party V as Bob. contents.html: In general, Bob has no assurance that party U is Alice, since Bob has no assurance concerning the accuracy of any identifier that may be used to label party U (unless, for example, the protocol using a key-transport scheme from the KTS-OAEP family also includes additional elements that establish a trusted association between an identifier for Alice and the ciphertext, C, that she sends to Bob while acting as party U). Due to Alice’s unilateral selection of the keying material, only she can obtain assurance of its freshness. (Her level of confidence concerning its freshness is dependent upon the actual manner in which the keying material is generated by/for her.) Given that Bob simply accepts the keying material that is transported to him by Alice, he has no assurance that it is fresh. The randomized plaintext encoding used during the RSA-OAEP.ENCRYPT operation can provide assurance to Alice that the value of C will change from one KTS-OAEP transaction with Bob to the next, which may help obfuscate the occurrence of a repeated transport of the same keying material from Alice to Bob, should that ever be necessary. The KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme permits party V to provide evidence to party U that keying material has been correctly recovered from the ciphertext C. contents.html: The acquisition of Bob’s RSA private key by their adversary, Eve, may lead to the compromise of keying material established during past, current, and future legitimate transactions (i.e., transactions that involve honest parties and are not actively influenced by an adversary) that employ the compromised private key. For example, Eve may be able to compromise a particular KTS-OAEP transaction between Alice and Bob, as long as she also acquires the ciphertext, C, sent from Alice to Bob. In addition to compromising legitimate KTS-OAEP transactions, once Eve has learned Bob’s RSA private key, she may be able to impersonate Bob while acting as party V in future KTS-OAEP transactions (with Alice or any other party). Other schemes and applications that rely on the compromised private key may also be adversely affected. (See the discussions of other schemes in this section.) Even without knowledge of Bob’s private key, if the KTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmation scheme is used during a particular key-transport transaction, and Eve learns the value of MacKey that Alice will send to Bob, then it may be possible for Eve to mislead Alice about Bob’s (active and successful) participation. As long as Eve also acquires the value of C intended for Bob (and any other data needed to form MacData ), it may be possible for Eve to correctly compute MacTagV V and return it to Alice as if it had come from Bob (who may not even be aware that Alice has initiated a transaction with him). Such circumstances could arise, for example, if (in violation of this Recommendation) Alice were to use the same MAC key while attempting to transport keying material to multiple parties (including both Bob and Eve).
contents.html_ja: 敵対者EveがBobのRSA秘密鍵を取得すると、その侵害鍵を使う過去、現在および将来の正当なトランザクション（正直な当事者が攻撃者から能動的影響を受けずに行うトランザクション）で確立した鍵素材が侵害され得る。例えばAliceからBobに送った暗号文CもEveが入手すれば、AliceとBob間の特定のKTS-OAEPトランザクションを侵害できる場合がある。正当なKTS-OAEPトランザクションを侵害するほか、BobのRSA秘密鍵を知ったEveは、将来KTS-OAEPでVとしてBobになりすませる場合がある。他のスキームやアプリケーションも侵害された秘密鍵に依存していれば悪影響を受け得る（本節の他のスキームの説明参照）。Bobの秘密鍵を知らなくても、特定の鍵転送トランザクションでKTS-OAEP-Party_V-confirmationを用い、AliceがBobに送るMacKeyをEveが知れば、Bobが能動的かつ正常に参加したとAliceに誤信させられる場合がある。Bob宛てのC（およびMacData作成に必要な他のデータ）もEveが取得すれば、MacTag_Vを正しく計算し、Bobから来たようにAliceへ返せる場合がある（BobはAliceがトランザクションを開始したことに気付かない可能性もある）。例えば、本勧告に違反してAliceがBobとEveを含む複数相手に鍵素材を転送する際、同じMAC鍵を使った場合にこうした事態が起こり得る。

contents.html: 10.4 Summary of Assurances Associated with Key-Establishment Schemes
contents.html_ja: 10.4 鍵確立スキームに伴う保証の概要

contents.html: The security-related features discussed in the preceding subsections of Section 10 can be summarized in terms of the following types of assurance that may be obtained when participating in a key-establishment transaction.
contents.html_ja: 第10節の前各小節で論じたセキュリティ機能を、鍵確立トランザクションへの参加時に得られる次の種類の保証として要約できる。

contents.html: Implicit Key Authentication (IKA): In the case of a key-agreement scheme from the KAS1 or KAS2 family, this is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-agreement transaction that only a specifically identified entity (the intended second party in that transaction) could also derive the key(s) of interest. In the case of a key-transport scheme from the KTS-OAEP family, this is the assurance obtained by the sender that only a specifically identified entity (the intended receiver in that transaction) could successfully decrypt the encrypted keying material to obtain the key(s) of interest.
contents.html_ja: 暗黙的鍵認証（IKA）：KAS1またはKAS2ファミリーの鍵合意スキームでは、鍵合意トランザクションの一方が、特定の識別された主体（そのトランザクションで意図する相手）だけが対象鍵を導出できる保証を得ることをいう。KTS-OAEPファミリーの鍵転送スキームでは、送信者が、特定の識別された主体（トランザクションで意図する受信者）だけが暗号化された鍵素材を正常に復号して対象鍵を得られる保証を得ることをいう。

contents.html: Key Freshness (KF): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-establishment transaction that keying material established during that transaction is statistically
contents.html_ja: 鍵の新鮮性（KF）：鍵確立トランザクションで確立した鍵素材が、当該参加者の以前の鍵確立トランザクションで確立した鍵素材と統計的に

contents.html: independent of the keying material established during that party’s previous key-establishment transactions.
contents.html_ja: 独立しているという保証を参加者が得ること。

contents.html: Key Confirmation (KC): This is the assurance obtained by one party in a key-establishment transaction that a specifically identified entity (the intended second party in that key-establishment transaction) has correctly acquired and is able to use, the key(s) of interest.
contents.html_ja: 鍵確認（KC）：鍵確立トランザクションの一方が、特定の識別された主体（当該トランザクションで意図する相手）が対象鍵を正しく取得し、使用できる保証を得ること。

contents.html: Notes: A participant in a key-establishment transaction cannot hope to distinguish between the actions of another entity and the actions of those who share knowledge of that entity’s private key-establishment key and/or any other secret data sufficient for that entity’s successful participation in a particular key-agreement transaction. In what follows, references to a “specifically identified entity” must be interpreted as an umbrella term including all those who are legitimately in possession of that entity’s private key, etc., and are trusted to act on the entity’s behalf. Any assurance obtained with respect to the actions of a specifically identified entity is conditioned upon the assumption that the identified entity’s relevant private/secret data has not been misused by a trusted party or compromised by an adversary. IKA assurance, as used in this Recommendation, does not address the potential compromise of established keying material owing to such problems as improper storage, the failure to prevent the leakage of sensitive information during computations involving the established keys, and/or inadequate methods for the timely destruction of sensitive data (including the keys themselves). These are just a few examples of misuse, mishandling, side-channel leakage, etc. that could lead to an eventual compromise. In the definition of KC assurance, this Recommendation’s requirement that it be a specifically identified entity who demonstrates the ability to use (some portion of) the established keying material is a stricter condition than is sometimes found in the literature. In this Recommendation, KC assurance presupposes IKA assurance with respect to (at least) the MAC key used in the key-confirmation computations. KC assurance can be obtained by employing a key-establishment scheme that includes key-confirmation as specified in this Recommendation. In particular, the KC provider is expected to use an RSA private key, and the KC recipient is expected to contribute random/ephemeral data that affects the values of both the MacKey and the MacData used to compute a key-confirmation MacTag.
contents.html_ja: 注：鍵確立トランザクションの参加者は、他の主体と、その主体の秘密鍵確立鍵および／または当該主体の参加成功に十分な他の秘密データを共有する者の行動を区別できない。以下で「特定の識別された主体」という場合、その主体の秘密鍵などを正当に所持し、その代理として行動することを信頼された者すべてを含む包括的な用語として解釈する。本勧告で得る保証は、特定された主体の関連する秘密鍵等が信頼された者に悪用されたり攻撃者に侵害されたりしていないとの仮定に基づく。本勧告におけるIKA保証は、不適切な保存、確立済み鍵の計算中の機微情報漏えい防止の不備、機微データ（鍵自体を含む）の適時破棄方法の不備などによる確立鍵素材の侵害可能性を扱わない。これらは悪用、不適切な取扱い、サイドチャネル漏えい等を通じて最終的な侵害につながる例の一部にすぎない。KC保証の定義では、確立鍵素材の（一部を）使用できる能力を示すのが特定の識別された主体であるとの要件を置き、文献で見られる場合より厳しい条件としている。本勧告では、KC保証は鍵確認計算に用いる少なくともMAC鍵に関するIKA保証を前提とする。本勧告で規定する鍵確認を含む鍵確立スキームでKC保証を得られる。特にKC提供者はRSA秘密鍵を用い、KC受領者は鍵確認MacTag計算に用いるMacKeyとMacDataの双方の値に影響するランダム／一時データを提供することを想定する。

The previous assumptions in Section 10 concerning the format and content of FixedInfo, the specificity of identifiers bound to RSA public keys, the randomness of nonces, etc., still hold.
